view.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a convenience store, focusing on multiple glass-door refrigerators stocked with various beverages. Above the coolers, red walls display advertisements featuring drinks and promotional slogans. The perspective is slightly tilted, giving a dynamic view of the brightly lit shelves and products.

objects.label: refrigerator
objects.observation: A large, multi-door refrigerator with glass doors filled with bottled and canned drinks. It has stainless steel frames and is positioned centrally in the frame. The interior lighting illuminates the colorful beverages on multiple shelves.

objects.label: refrigerator
objects.observation: Another refrigerator to the right, partially visible, also with glass doors and stocked with beverages. Its door handle is visible, and it appears to be adjacent to the central unit. The contents are less clear due to glare and reflection.

objects.label: advertisement
objects.observation: A rectangular advertisement poster mounted on the red wall above the refrigerators. It features a yellow drink bottle and Chinese text promoting '果粒好味道' (fruit granule good taste). The poster is framed and clearly visible against the red background.

objects.label: advertisement
objects.observation: A second advertisement poster to the right of the first, showing a person holding a bottle and Chinese text. It is partially obscured by the edge of the frame but still legible. The poster is mounted similarly to the first one.

objects.label: bottles and cans
objects.observation: Numerous bottles and cans of various colors and sizes are visible inside the refrigerators. They are arranged neatly on white plastic shelves. Some are transparent, others opaque, with labels in different hues, indicating diverse beverage types.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000045", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
